title: Robotics & Automation
summary: Precision brackets, machined mounting components and fabricated frames for automation equipment.
intro: Automation equipment is tolerance-sensitive in a way that suits our combination of pressing and machining. A mounting bracket that positions a sensor or an actuator has to locate accurately or the machine does not work — which puts the requirement squarely in machined-feature territory.
body: Our route handles both parts of that: the bracket body formed or laser-cut economically, and the critical bores, faces and tapped features machined on our CNC/VMC line within a 1300 × 800 mm envelope. Same supplier, one inspection record, no shipping parts out for a single machining operation.
We also build jigs, fixtures and mounting frames as custom fabrication work, which is often what automation integrators actually need in small quantities.

This is a target sector. Our credential is precision discipline proven on automotive tooling rather than a portfolio of robotics customers, and we would rather you evaluate us on a trial part than on a claim.
